text:
jaya: Support here — multiple customers reporting 504s and intermittent 5xx for hosted inference since ~08:10 UTC. P99 tail latency spiking to 8-12s, p95 up ~2s. Errors look like gateway timeouts + request queue rejects.

matt: seeing the same in metrics — continuous-batcher queue depth hit limit on thinpool-3 at 08:09, backlog grew ~x4. Eviction rate went up, KV cache spin noted in logs.

elaine: any common client pattern? long seqs? large batch sizes?

jaya: repro from one customer: curl to /v1/generate with model=redwood-large, seq_len=2048, many small concurrent requests (~80/s) from a single tenant. They hit early_rejects and then gateway 504s.

matt: quick grep from batcher logs:
```
[08:09:21] batcher: enqueue req tenant=acme id=0x7f queue_depth=256 max_queue=256
[08:09:21] batcher: backlog=1234 pending_tokens=89 continuous-batcher:kv-spin=1.2s
[08:09:22] gateway: proxy timeout to runtime: upstream closed connection
```

kim: ops-bot alerted at 08:11 — auto-scale didn't trigger because thinpool-3 was at reserved capacity. We hit per-pool queue_depth limits, so requests were early-rejected not queued more.

rafa: possible mitigation: temporarily increase max_queue_depth for thinpool-3 and enable burst_capacity, or route tenant to dedicated fallback model-variant (quantized) to lower per-token runtime. But need canary.

elaine: prefer quick config change: reduce continuous-batcher max_batch_wait_ms from 12ms -> 6ms to reduce latency tailing, and lower max_prefetch for KV cache to avoid spin. That should shrink batching windows and avoid long tail accumulation.

matt: steps I'll run now: 1) open canary to thinpool-3 only, 2) apply max_batch_wait_ms=6 on canary, 3) increase pool max_queue_depth + enable one-shot burst for 10m, 4) monitor p95/p99 and early_rejects.

jaya: sending customer note: "we're triaging a scheduling/backlog issue; applying mitigations and will update in 15m" :thumbsup:

kim: created incident runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-tail-triage (added logs). ops-bot will post updates.

ops-bot: [action] canary rollout started at 08:18: cron-job-id=cb-canary-6888654321.

matt: after config change (08:21) p99 dropped to ~3.2s, early_rejects decreased 90%. Still watching.

rafa: follow-up: need a postmortem to add adaptive per-tenant throttles and make burst_capacity automatic for thinpools. Also evaluate changing default continuous-batcher heuristics for long-seq workloads.

jaya: noted — will coordinate postmortem + customer follow-up. Thanks team.
